example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই পরিত্যক্ত বাড়িটি যমপুরীর মতো ভয়ঙ্কর লাগছে।
example_sentences_in_english: That abandoned house feels as terrifying as hell.
The battlefield seems like the abode of Yama.
history: Derived from Hindu mythology, where Yama is the god of death ruling over the afterlife realm known as Yamaloka or Yamapuri.
note: These idioms evoke the Hindu concept of the afterlife, commonly used in Bengali literature and everyday speech to describe frightening locations.
